sampling.interpretation: Native JSON legality and individual 0/1 token logprob agreement only; no fallback, action-quality accuracy or test-set model selection.

observable_update.criterion: All probes and belief probes each exceed the noise/floor threshold and reload matching tolerance.

optimizer_restore.live_branch: original client retained across the trial

optimizer_negative_control.criterion: Live continuation differs from weight-only restoration beyond both matching tolerance and measured baseline noise floor.

training.interpretation: Finite validation probes must distinguish updated weights and restored optimizer state from unupdated/weight-only controls; this is not loss improvement, parameter equality proof or playing strength.

plan.scope: Three caller probes, one reloaded probe, three branch probes and updates; includes weight-only negative control; excludes sampler checks and checkpoint storage.

cost_accounting.accounting: token-based estimate; generated-token upper bounds are separate from observed completion_tokens; provider invoice not inferred
